tips_en: Start with L3G (paper 2): it offers the clearest integrated systems contribution, combining adaptive 3D Gaussian memory with a few-step video DiT and compelling evidence of real-time, long-horizon consistency and efficiency. Read IDM alongside it as another efficiency-preservation approach—matching feature statistics in fast image generation parallels maintaining compact latent memory in world generation—then consult the LLM memory study for the broader lesson about when engineered memory creates a “memory tax” versus simply retrieving raw history.
tips_zh: 建议先读L3G（第2篇）：它将自适应3D高斯记忆、少步视频DiT与实时长时一致性整合成了完整的系统方案，且效率提升证据最直观。可将IDM作为并行阅读——它通过统计匹配减少少步生成中的细节损失，与L3G利用紧凑持久记忆维持世界一致性相呼应；再读LLM记忆论文，思考更一般的问题：构建记忆何时会产生相对直接检索的“记忆税”。
